subject: Intro + next steps: identifying economic owner and procurement timeline
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <ajohnson@acmeindustries.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyanka Desai <priyanka.desai@medworks.io>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + discovery recap

Vivek / team,

Thanks for the demo this morning — good overview and I appreciated the focus on latency and cost controls. Quick recap from my side and a couple of asks so we can move this to procurement: 

- Business need: reduce token cost and stabilize p99 latency for our customer-facing question-answer feature.
- Expected Q3 pilot scope: ~3M tokens/month, 2 models (high-accuracy + low-latency fallback).
- Decision criteria: unit cost, quantization support, SOC2+infosec posture, contract length.

Action items for us: can you confirm who on your side will own the economic conversation (pricing/commit terms) so I can align internally? On our side I'll confirm the economic owner and procurement timeline — I suspect it will be Priyanka (VP, Finance) but need to confirm.

Can you also send a short summary (1-pager) of the proposed engagement model and an initial draft SOW or proposal we can circulate with procurement/legal? We attached our vendor intake form — happy to complete it.

Attachments: vendor_intake_form.pdf (from Acme)

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Director, Platform Product
Acme Industries
+1 415 555 0192
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <ajohnson@acmeindustries.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery recap

Alex — great speaking with you. Short answers and next steps: 

1) Economic owner on our side: I'll lead commercial discussions initially and Marissa (cc'd) will own SOW/pricing details and procurement coordination. Ben (cc'd) will support on technical gating and infosec questions.

2) Deliverables we will share by Friday:
   - 1-page engagement summary (attachment: redwood_onepager.pdf)
   - Draft SOW (attachment: SOW_acme_draft.docx)
   - Short infosec checklist and SOC2 summary (attachment: redwood_security_summary.pdf)

3) Proposed timeline:
   - This week: circulate materials to Acme procurement/legal
   - Next week: 30-min commercial sync to discuss commitment tiers and discounts
   - 2-3 weeks: procurement + legal review window (typical)

Two quick asks for you: please confirm the economic buyer name and whether procurement requires an initial NDA or PO/contract template. If Priyanka is the econ owner, would you introduce us? If you prefer, we can reach out after you confirm.

I'll also include a short pricing sketch in the commercial sync.

Attachments (stubs): redwood_onepager.pdf, SOW_acme_draft.docx, redwood_security_summary.pdf

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Intro + discovery recap — internal plan to reach econ owner

Team — forwarding Alex's note and my reply. Short plan so we can move quickly: 

- Marissa: please draft a concise commercial email to send to Priyanka (intro + high-level pricing tiers + ask for procurement timeline). Keep the ask light: confirm econ owner, ask for procurement checklist and any contract template. I can be on the intro thread.
- Ben: prepare the infosec artifact pack (SOC2, logging/retention notes, network requirements) so we can attach to the outreach. Prioritize items procurement usually requests.
- Timeline: target outreach to econ owner tomorrow; aim for commercial sync the week of 5/10.
- Pricing note: propose 12-month reserved + burst capacity pricing with a pilot discount; leave room for negotiation if they need a shorter term.

Also flag: Alex mentioned requirement for p99 latency — Ben please include expected p99 numbers for our recommended config and agent model options in the artifact pack.

I'll draft the intro email and route through Marissa before sending.

Vivek
From: Alex Johnson <ajohnson@acmeindustries.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyanka Desai <priyanka.desai@medworks.io>
Date: 2027-05-05T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + next steps: identifying economic owner and procurement timeline

Vivek — thanks, and apologies for the delay confirming. Quick update from my side: 

- Economic buyer / budget owner: Priyanka Desai (VP, Finance) — looped here. She will own commercial sign-off and budget allocation.
- Procurement process: initial vendor intake → legal review → infosec review (SOC2 + pen-test attestation) → contract negotiation → PO issuance. Typical internal window is ~2–4 weeks for straightforward vendors.
- Timeline preference: we'd like a 3-week timeline to get to a signed pilot SOW. Legal will want the standard Master Services Agreement; procurement prefers receiving a redlined MSA rather than starting from scratch.

Priyanka — Vivek and Marissa from Redwood will share the SOW and security artifacts. Can you confirm if procurement needs any additional paperwork (NDA, specific PO terms)?

Attachments: acme_vendor_intake_filled.pdf, acme_sow_requirements.docx

Thanks,
Alex

On behalf of Priyanka Desai (copied)
